decisions.reason: The source explicitly concerns landing-page adjustments; it does not change the separate About-page How It Works content.

The candidate already requires no cropping and full cover visibility. The source reiterates that still-unimplemented expectation but does not change its requirement state, and implementation status must not be propagated.
The invitation-label change applies to the landing page's How It Works section, not the separate FAQ content.
Neither the book-cover refit nor the invitation-label wording changes the current or planned product name.
The landing-page presentation and label adjustments do not alter email authentication or dashboard access behavior.
The source does not change email delivery, notification channels, or confirmation-email contents.
The source contains no change to SIWE, wallet authentication, or fiat-buyer dashboard access.
Changing a landing-page invitation label to 'invite & collect rewards' does not change automatic prize payout or claim-flow behavior.
The source does not affect authentication requirements or information exposed through public APIs.
The landing-page wording change does not alter the no-referral commission amount, trigger, or recipient-selection rule.
The source does not change the Transak provider, fiat-mint flow, wallet provisioning, or the requirement's deferred lifecycle.
The landing-page cover and invitation-label adjustments do not change any NFT transfer or carried-asset semantics.
